priority_1_duplicate_pois.description: Re-implement frontend deduplication for Kanban view. When the same POI name appears in multiple category data files for the same day, show it only in the primary category.
priority_1_duplicate_pois.rationale: The data files legitimately categorize some POIs in multiple ways (e.g., 锦里古街 is both an attraction, entertainment venue, and shopping area). The frontend should deduplicate by showing each POI name only once, in the highest-priority category.
priority_1_duplicate_pois.alternative: If keeping multi-category display is intentional, add a visual indicator (e.g., badge/tag) showing the POI belongs to multiple categories, rather than showing separate full cards.
